# HISAT2

`nf-core/hisat2`

A fast and sensitive aligner that maps sequencing reads, DNA or RNA, to a reference genome. Here it builds the genome index and aligns RNA-seq reads to it.

Homepage: https://daehwankimlab.github.io/hisat2/

Cite: doi:10.1038/s41587-019-0201-4
